name: convo
description: Keeps every Claude Code conversation as git history: one commit per turn, a branch per session and subagent, keyframes in place of compaction, merge and recall by asking, all local and redacted.

compactAt.title: Compact at (tokens)
compactAt.description: Compact with a keyframe once the context reaches this many tokens, setup included (50000 or more). 0 leaves compaction to Claude Code's own limit.

clearOldOutput.title: Clear old tool output
clearOldOutput.description: Once a lot of old tool output piles up, replace it in the context with a stub pointing to git, as a turn ends.

holdBackTools.title: Hold back unused tools
holdBackTools.description: Put built-in tools this project has not used in a week or more of history behind ToolSearch; Claude loads one when it needs it.

keepTools.title: Always keep these tools
keepTools.description: Tool names never held back, separated by commas (for example: WebFetch, NotebookEdit).
